w: So what new spending is the City asking for? Next year, its requests add up to about three hundred fifty-five million dollars. That is a separate figure from the tax increase: the requests do not say how much property tax would pay for. Nearly a third falls under safety: the Safer Together plan, police, and more transit peace officers. Almost as much falls under infrastructure, led by infrastructure maintenance, starting at sixty-two million dollars a year. Transportation comes next, mostly transit: a low-income pass and more service. And nearly eight of every ten dollars is ongoing. If approved, it would carry into later years' budgets.
